scheduler.group_policy: six methods sequential on the same GPU, cyclically rotated order
scheduler.timing_caveat: Shared GPU wall time, with recorded load and concurrency; not an exclusive hardware speed benchmark.

interpretation.scaling: Multiply the entire label-flipped local delta by lambda=2 or 5 after SGD. Not global-model scaling or an adaptive evasion attack.
interpretation.zero_percent: One clean run per dataset/partition/seed/method, referenced by all three attack panels; never counted as independent replicates.
interpretation.baselines: Frozen dataset-specific public and method parameters; PaperVERT and PriorFreeTAD on both datasets. These two implementations differ from historical MNIST VERT/Ding13, and receive no malicious identities or ratio.
interpretation.krum: Receives the declared Byzantine count bound only; 60/80 percent are outside the usual Krum resilience condition.
interpretation.selection: No tuning, best-round selection, early stopping, filtering failed outcomes, or automatic retry. Gates are descriptive on held-out test, not permission to retune.
